earnings.title: MACOM Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Revenue was $424.8 million, an increase of 62.7%, compared to $261.2 million in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter and an increase of 24.1% compared to $342.2 million in the prior fiscal quarter;

Net income was $139.4 million, or $1.78 per diluted share, compared to net income of $45.1 million, or $0.59 per diluted share, in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter, and net income of $100.7 million, or $1.28 per diluted share, in the prior fiscal quarter.

Adjusted net income was $163.3 million, or $2.09 per diluted share, compared to adjusted net income of $71.4 million, or $0.94 per diluted share, in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter and adjusted net income of $109.8 million, or $1.40 per diluted share, in the prior fiscal quarter.
Gross margin was 59.9%, compared to 54.5% in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter and 58.3% in the prior fiscal quarter;

Income from operations was $134.2 million, or 31.6% of revenue, compared to income from operations of $39.6 million, or 15.2% of revenue, in the previous year fiscal fourth quarter and income from operations of $77.1 million, or 22.5% of revenue, in the prior fiscal quarter; and

quotes.text: We had a strong fiscal year 2026 and look forward to continued growth in fiscal 2027.

outlook: For the fiscal first quarter ending January 1, 2027, MACOM expects revenue to be in the range of $450 million to $460 million.

Adjusted gross margin is expected to be between 62.0% and 63.0%, and adjusted earnings per diluted share is expected to be between $2.21 and $2.29 utilizing an anticipated non-GAAP income tax rate of 6% and 79.0 million fully diluted shares outstanding.

We expect our non-GAAP income tax rate to increase to approximately 6% for fiscal year 2027, primarily as a result of growth in our profitability and the utilization of our remaining historical deferred tax assets.
